subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `memory.recall`, `memory.capture`, `memory.compaction`, `memory.dreaming`, and `memory.userModel`, including per-agent overrides, as its durable memory plugin contract after the two routing defects are fixed?
rationale: Code review can require canonical migration and correct isolation, but it cannot decide the permanent public role taxonomy, fallback semantics, or whether all five roles should ship together.

options.title: Adopt all five roles
options.body: Keep the proposed taxonomy, require canonical-only runtime reads and agent-scoped invocation, then land after exact-head upgrade and isolation proof.

options.title: Ship a narrower first contract
options.body: Land only roles with complete explicit invocation paths, such as recall and compaction, and defer hook-driven roles to later API work.

options.title: Prefer a generic ownership API
options.body: Pause this PR and use a broader scoped capability or slot-owner contract before defining memory-specific role keys.

recommendation.title: Adopt all five roles
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed taxonomy, require canonical-only runtime reads and agent-scoped invocation, then land after exact-head upgrade and isolation proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history attributes the existing slot and memory capability contract being replaced to his merged work, with continued recent activity across memory, loader, and hook surfaces.
